commands.stdout:
usage: author_source_references.py [-h] {prepare,author} ...

Independent full-section A/B/C references with six frozen original-PDF
challenges. Preparation reads selected source views and their archived release
only. Authoring runs three fresh tool-free Claude sessions; it never reads
predictions or writes reference/production database rows. After extraction,
root can register each retained unit batch through
evaluate.semantic.record_pass with its retained native frame.

positional arguments:
  {prepare,author}

options:
  -h, --help        show this help message and exit

usage: register_source_references.py [-h] --input INPUT --output OUTPUT

Register retained independent source-only authors through evaluator-owned
operations. Run only after the exact source-bound extraction is completed.
This script never changes the six expected source facts or reads prediction
content to author a pass.

options:

  --output OUTPUT
